entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker quoted criticizing the archons' ancient, flawed premise of justice.

entities.name: Avacyn's Collar

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: The realm Syr Tasdale serves as a knight.

entities.description: A limited magical metal infused into life on Esper.

entities.name: Vastlands
entities.description: A place whose name first-years quickly learn the reason for.

entities.description: An academy whose students may be sent to study with a stern spirit.

entities.name: Ivold
entities.description: An inventor who believes he may at last be seeing geists through his lenses.

entities.name: Doen
entities.description: A purveyor of exotic pets.

entities.description: A member of the Mirran resistance who defies a monster.

entities.name: Sarnvax
entities.description: A Gitaxian sective who threatens a foe.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An experimenter whose results made her consider that multitudinous realities existed.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A Tazeem lullmage quoted taunting foes.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The region Noyan Dar hails from.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Called great and glorious by a Stronghold architect who would scribe his name in blood.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A cruel figure who crows that those who fought together will die together.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and necromancer fond of the moment roaring becomes squealing.

entities.name: Wyndmoor Street
entities.description: A street whose lamps snuff themselves at midnight.

entities.description: A planeswalker who trespassed into Nyx.

entities.description: The realm Elspeth trespassed into.

entities.name: Dominaria

entities.description: A planeswalker and task mage advising not to question where mana comes from.

entities.name: Ellywick Tumblestrum

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Quoted commenting on an ouphe that steals power from treasures.

entities.name: Taaveti of Kelsinko
entities.description: An elvish hunter who teaches that guidance is always there if sought.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who observes Zendikar's enraged nature; he was warned that Ravnica would fall apart if he neglected his responsibilities.

entities.description: A plane left forever enraged by Eldrazi relics.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Mysterious beings whose relics enraged Zendikar.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane said to fall apart without Jace's responsible leadership.

entities.description: A Phyrexian who boasts his creations outmatch Jin-Gitaxias's minions.

entities.description: A Phyrexian whose minions Vorinclex scorns as septic.

entities.description: A group that suspended its policy of lifetime guarantees.

entities.description: Students who dance between passion and perfection.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A dangerous source of innovations and technology.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Rimewind master who praises Phyrexian technology and calls Arcum a fool.

entities.name: Arcum
entities.description: Dismissed by Heidar as a babbling fool.

entities.description: An organization whose vault held the Mirari.

entities.description: A land across which the Mirari's darkness radiated.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Quoted on crowns and hats.

entities.description: A planeswalker who calms a powerstone and repairs the Weatherlight's planeswalking engine.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Wizards who trade knowledge on magic scrolls.

entities.name: Pemmin
entities.description: A Riptide survivor with a sharp tongue.

entities.name: The Patriarch
entities.description: A long-dead figure whose name cultists still speak.

entities.name: Mirri

entities.description: A planeswalker quoted saying "You."

events.summary: Ivold, peering through his lenses, thinks he may be seeing geists at last.
Rashmi's experiments lead her to consider that other realities exist.
events.quote: The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.

events.summary: Crovax gloats over enemies who will die together.
Elspeth trespasses into Nyx and fears retribution.
events.quote: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.

events.summary: The Knights of the Reliquary set off on a crusade after the tower is found in Esper.
events.quote: the Knights of the Reliquary set off on a righteous crusade to recover their lost treasures.

events.summary: O-Kagachi's demand begins the Kami War.
events.quote: At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.

events.summary: Karn stops a powerstone's wild flashing by squeezing it.
events.quote: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly.

events.summary: Numsgil becomes goblin king by doing in Blog, in a line of usurpations.
events.quote: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok . . . .

events.summary: Karn repairs the Weatherlight's planeswalking engine and sees how to catalyze its evolution.
events.quote: As he repaired the ship's planeswalking engine, Karn saw for the first time how he could catalyze the *Weatherlight*'s evolution.

events.summary: Sisay continues the quest for the Legacy after Gerrard abandons it.
events.quote: Sisay continued the quest for the Legacy even when Gerrard chose to abandon it.
The heir to the Legacy has finally returned to the *Weatherlight*.
